verdict.rationale: ClickUp ships AI features (Brain², agents, multiple frontier models), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a setting, policy, or contractual commitment that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The claim that Brain² 'learns how you and your team talk' describes personalization, not a training-data control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
